7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: Updated the Frost Lich tooltip to reflect its current effect.

7.description: Savage Strikes now gives 5/6% crit, down from 8/10%.

7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: Improved Devotion Aura rank 3 was providing more bonus armor and healing than was stated on the item tooltip. The altar tooltip and its effect have been changed to match the item tooltip.

5.description: Lifegiving Gem now gives 2000 health, up from 1500.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Fixed a bug where Lifegiving Gem was healing for higher than intended.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Lifegiving Gem is now usable while shapeshifted.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Aegis of Preservation is now usable while shapeshifted.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Fixed a bug where Netherwind Regalia 8-set bonus wouldn??t trigger from Arcane Missile damage.

2.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
2.description: Fixed an issue where the Mystic Orb Shard drop rate from Elemental Invasion mobs was incorrect on Andorhal.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Fixed a bug where Onyxia Blood Talisman became unique-equipped (will be fixed after next server restart).

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Removed the resilience from gear the "Accessories Quartermaster" is selling.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Wolfshead Helm is now working as intended, giving energy and rage when it should.

0.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
0.description: All equippable unique items should now be unique-equipped instead.

0.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
0.description: The Focused Assault debuff which increases damage taken in Warsong Gulch will now appear when both flags are picked up for 5 minutes, instead of 10. The Brutal Assault debuff will appear after 10 minutes, instead of 15.

0.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
0.description: Fixed a bug where you couldn't always Charge and Intercept in water.

0.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
0.description: Wands now deal school damage and slightly scales with spell power.

0.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
0.description: Fixed a bug where Hunter pets and Warlock demons wouldn't gain hit and expertise based on their owners hit.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fixed a bug where Elemental Focus could be triggered by Chimera Shot.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Serrated Blades can now proc from melee abilities.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fingers of Frost now has a chance to proc whenever you deal Frost damage. (For example on Frost Shock and Frostbrand.)

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Immolation Trap ranged attack power scaling changed to 90%, down from 100%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fear duration on players have been reduced. Rank 1 now lasts 5 seconds.. Rank 2 lasts 6 seconds. Rank 3 lasts 8 seconds.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: You can no longer use Soul Link together with an Imp.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Seal of Righteousness now does 20% less damage to players. (Still does the same damage to mobs.)

8.author: Exey(73692347044474880)
8.description: What the Wind Carries (Part of the Onyxia attunement chain) can now be taken.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: The shoulder enchants bought from honor are now tradable on Laughing Skull.

5.author: Tobi (Yackon)(199946996163805185)
5.description: Fixed an unexpected issue where some gossips would not recover lost ZG Neck pieces.

5.author: Epoch(459440876188598283)
5.description: Blessing of Holy Light is now tradable as intended.

5.author: Exey(73692347044474880)
5.description: Corrected an issue where you were unable to recover lost ZG Neck pieces.

1.author: Hundoslavus(167371138324889600)
1.description: Lunar Guidance now provides 4/7/10% of your Intellect as spell damage instead of spell power, up from 2/4/6%

1.author: Hundoslavus(167371138324889600)
1.description: Cataclysm no longer reduces the mana cost of your Destruction Warlock spells, but now increases the damage of your Hellfire, Rain of Fire, Inferno, and Shadowfury spells by 10/20/30%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Vile Poisons now properly increases the damage over time effect of Deadly Poison by 10% per rank.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fixed a bug where the Turn the Tables buff was able to proc weapon effects and enchants.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fixed a bug where the Black Arrow damage increase was too high.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed a bug which was reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning for some players.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed a bug which that was increasing the damage of Seal of Righteousness by 20% and Judgements by 10% for some players.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Counterattack scaling reduced to 70% of ranged attack power, from 90%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Fixed an issue that made Slam (rank 4) unusable.

5.author: Hundoslavus(167371138324889600)
5.description: Venomous Totem is now usable while shapeshifted.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue where Mental Quickness would be unlearned after a spec swap.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue where Unleashed Rage was giving more ranged attack power than intended.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue where the Clearcast effect from Arcane Concentration would be consumed by dot ticks.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue where the Living Bomb explosion wouldn't go off if you didn't have line of sight of your target.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue with Wild Hunt not giving your pet the extra stats.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: The Maelstrom Weapon effect now also reduces the cast time Fireball and Frostbolt, but does not increase their damage.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Mental Strength has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 4/7/10% Intellect and 2/4/6% reduced spell damage taken.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Empowered Rejuvenation has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 7/14/20% of your bonus healing effects to your Druid healing over time effects.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Mortal Shots has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 7/14/20% bonus critical damage.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Natural Alacrity's cooldown has been reduced to 2 min, from 3. Now also increases your Nature healing done by 10% for 20 seconds.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Demonic Resilience now also increases the threat generated while under the effects of Metamorphosis by 10/20/30%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Anger Management now provides 2 rage every 3 seconds, up from 1.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Missile Barrage has been reduced to 3 ranks and now gives your Arcane Blast and Starfire spells a 14/27/40% chance, and your Arcane Barrage, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, and Moonfire spells a 7/14/20% chance to trigger the Missile Barrage effect.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Curse of Agony now scales with 12% of your spell power per tick, up from 10%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Smack (pet) scaling has been increased to 8% ranged attack power.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Claw (pet) scaling has been increased to 8% ranged attack power.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Bite (pet) scaling has been increased to 8% ranged attack power.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Divine Strength has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 3/6/9% Strength.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Sinister Calling has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% Agility and 4/7/10% bonus damage of Backstab and Hemorrhage.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Flurry has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 5/10/15% melee haste.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Holy Guidance has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 4/8/12% of your Intellect as healing power and Holy spell power.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Shredding Blows has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 4/8/12% armor penetration.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Furor has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% Intellect while in Moonkin form, 3/6/9% Stamina while in Bear and Dire Bear form, and 2/4/6% damage while in Cat form.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Heart of the Wild has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 3/6/9% Intellect and 2/4/6% Stamina while in Bear and Dire Bear form, and 2/4/6% attack power in Cat form.

1.description: Kidney Shot now costs 1 AE.

1.description: Deadly Throw now costs 1 AE.

1.description: Rupture now costs 1 AE.

1.description: Slice and Dice now costs 1 AE.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Eviscerate now costs 1 AE.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Arcane Mind has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 4/7/10% Intellect, increases the damage of your spells by 1/2/3%, and increases the mana cost of your spells 1/2/3%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Lethality has been reduced to 3 ranks and provides 10/20/30% additional critical damage bonus.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Master Marksman has been reduced by 3 ranks and now provides 1/2/3% critical strike chance and 7/14/20% reduced mana cost of Aimed Shot, Steady Shot, Chimera Shot, and Multi-Shot.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Mind Mastery has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% of your Intellect as spell power and reduces the mana cost of all spells by 2/4/6%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Divine Intellect has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% Intellect and increases your Holy critical strike chance by 1/2/3%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Ancestral Knowledge has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% Intellect and reduces the mana cost of all Shaman spells by 4/7/10%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Shadow Mastery has been reduced to 3 ranks and provides 2/4/6% increased Shadow damage dealt and life drained.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Improved Berserker Stance has been reduced to 3 ranks and now provides 2/4/6% Strength and 5/10/15% reduced threat while in Berserker Stance.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Deadliness has been reduced to 3 ranks and provides 2/4/6% attack power.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Hunter vs. Wild now grants 7/14/20% of your Stamina as attack power and ranged attack power. Now gives your tamed pet 5/10/15% increased health and 2/4/6% increased damage.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Windfury Weapon now deals 100% of your weapon damage while using One-Handed weapons, up from 70%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: You now gain 1.75 attack power from Agility while in Cat Form, down from 2.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Cornered (Cunning Pet Talent) damage bonus has been reduced to 10/20% from 25/50%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Fixed an issue where you weren't able to cast some channeled spells while under the effects of Divine Shield.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Piercing Shots now causes the target to bleed for 14/27/40% damage, up from 10/20/30%. It can now also proc from Arcane Shot.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Molten Skin has been reworked. Now instead of reducing damage taken, it reduces the damage you take from your Hellfire by 10/20/30%, and you gain a 3/6/9% chance after being struck.to increase your fire damage dealt by 10% for 10 seconds.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Sheath of Light now updates your character sheet as your attack power changes.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Mental Quickness now updates your character sheet as your attack power changes.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Hellfire damage scaling increased to 17% per tick, up from 14.5%, self damage scaling increased to 10.9%, up from 9.5% Additionally Hellfire can now critical strike (enemies only).

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Unrelenting Storm now grants you 4/8/12% of your Intellect as mana regen, up from 3/6/9%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Naturalist now also increases the critical strike chance of your Healing Touch by 3/6/9%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Dreamstate now grants you 4/7/10% of your Intellect as mana regen, up from 2/4/6%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Improved Steady Show now has a 17/34/50% chance to proc, up from 10/20/30%. Now also grants 20% increased damage, up from 15%, to Arcane Shot, Aimed Shot, and Multi-Shot. Additionally it now reduces the mana cost of these spells by 25%, up from 20%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Serendipity now grants 5/10/15% reduced cast time of your Great Heal and Prayer of Healing spells per rank, up from 4/8/12%, and can now also be triggered by Smite.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Invigoration now grants 2% mana, up from 1%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Bane now also reduces the mana cost of your Destruction Warlock spells by 4/7/10%.

1.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
1.description: Sniper Training now also affects Arcane Shot.
